text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is over. There's a slight
hint of
autumn in the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We have to head back to the academy
and start
preparing for the autumn races.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whew. The beginning kinda sucked...
but it
turned out to be a nice and lazy
summer in the
end.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I feel like the weight that's been buildin'
up inside
me since my debut has all been
washed away.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer. Wanna start workin'
toward my
autumn goal?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, but more than just the race
itself.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You know that certain someone who's
always
gettin' on my nerves? I think
she'll be in the Shuka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yup. Remember what she said at the end
of
spring?
choice_data_list: ダイワスカーレットか
ダイワスカーレットだね

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
While you're recovering from your
setback, I'm
going to be getting
stronger! I'll be so strong that
you'll
definitely want to run against me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Just wait until fall. I'm not letting you off the hook. Or more like, you'll be begging to race me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She's the one who threw down the
gauntlet, so
she's definitely gonna bring
a good fight.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet keeps callin' herself "number
one" for a
reason.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And I... wanna see what that reason is.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I guess... But I kinda want this for
myself
too.
choice_data_list: ダイワスカーレットのために？

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I was super cool at the Derby. But, then I
really
screwed up afterwards, which was
super lame.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I wanna get a fresh start this autumn! I'm
lookin'
for somethin' even cooler than
the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And I sorta feel like Scarlet's the one
who'll show
me what that "something" is.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We're different now than we were in the
spring. I
wanna start this season off by
racing against her.
